facts.fact: Mauritania's national toponymy commission (CNT) reports developing a mobile geolocation application for Nouakchott, with an inventory of the city's infrastructure and services, with a view to a modern addressing of the city.
facts.system: Application mobile de géolocalisation de Nouakchott

systems.system: Application mobile de géolocalisation de Nouakchott

MRT.note: The document states nothing on a link between the civil register and the ID system; it only says the CNT shares toponymic databases with the population register agency.
It mentions the 2013 census only as a source of place-name counts; that count predates the ten-year window and no preparation or survey is stated.
Nothing stated on a number at birth.
Nothing stated on local government office connection.
Nothing stated on civil registration offices.
